description: Create an ad distribution request to send a message to contacts in pool lists matching target demographics. Deducts from wallet upon approval.

budget.description: Total ad budget in kobo (e.g., 500000 = NGN 5,000)

chatPhone.description: Optional reply-to WhatsApp number, like an email reply-to address. When given, the ad ends with 'Chat with <business> on WhatsApp' and people who tap it message this number, not the creator (counted when trackLinks is on). Omit it and no chat line is added.

mediaUrl.description: Media URL for non-text messages (required when messageType is 'image', 'video', or 'document')

message.description: The ad message content to distribute to matched contacts

targetDemographics.description: Demographic criteria to match against pool list entries

targetGoal.description: Target number of successful message deliveries

trackLinks.description: Opt in to results tracking: links in the message go out as neuron.ng/t/ short links so taps are counted per audience. Default false: links go out exactly as written (deliveries and reads are still reported).

name: neuron_create_ad_request
title: Create Ad Request
